name: gob.ec
body: A one-year HSTS, real 404s for unknown paths, dates on its pages, and pages that read well without JavaScript. But the home page has no <main> landmark and its search field has no label, so screen readers lose their way.
lesson: Wrap content in one <main> and label the search box; screen readers jump to both.
summary: www.gob.ec scores 76 out of 100 (C). 1 check fails now, 25 are at risk, and 14 pass. Fix first: 2 form controls have no label.

fix.title: 2 form controls have no label
fix.evidence: On /, /tramites/lista. Screen readers announce them as an unnamed field.
fix.fix: Pair each control with <label for>, wrap it in a label, or add aria-label.

fix.title: 11 pages have no meta description
fix.evidence: /, /tramites/lista, /instituciones, /articulos/tramites-linea and 7 more. Google and AI answers then write their own snippet from whatever text they find.
fix.fix: Write a 50 to 160 character description for each page that says what a reader gets.

fix.title: No content security policy
fix.evidence: content-security-policy was absent on the start page. Missing on all 11 pages read. Injected scripts are not limited by the browser.
fix.fix: Start with the Report-Only policy in the fix kit, watch the reports for a week, then enforce it.

fix.title: 11 images have no alt attribute
fix.fix: Describe informative images. Give decorative ones alt="".

fix.title: Tracking tags load with no consent tool in the page
fix.evidence: Google Analytics 4 appears in the HTML and no consent platform or Google Consent Mode default was found. In the EU, the UK, Brazil, and Colombia this is a legal exposure.
fix.fix: Add a consent platform and set Google Consent Mode v2 defaults to denied before any tag loads.

works.title: AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page
Plain http does not serve the site
The start page declares its language
The start page arrived in 773 ms
The start page sets a mobile viewport
